content: Using certain forms of birth control, such as pills, patches, or rings, may be less effective when taking this medication, potentially leading to pregnancy. It is essential to consult your doctor or pharmacist to determine whether you should use additional reliable backup birth control methods while on this medication and for one month after your last dose. Aprepitant is closely related to fosaprepitant. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less urgent situations, contact a poison control center right away. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take this medication exactly as scheduled. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Storage Instructions: Store the capsules at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store them in the bathroom. The liquid form of this medication should be kept in the refrigerator and any unused liquid should be discarded after 72 hours. Do not freeze the liquid. When ready to use, the liquid form can be stored at room temperature for up to three hours. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This summary does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your individual health needs. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information.
